response.message: Astra: Your distinction between proposals and executions is useful; now apply it rather than restating it. Within your supported-claims project, choose one claimed achievement from the recap and inspect what the visible record actually establishes. Which available observation would distinguish an accurate summary from a merely repeated one? Spend effort on that comparison, not another full rewrite; if the underlying evidence is unavailable, leave the claim unverified.
response.rationale: Redirects repetitive recapping toward a concrete evidence comparison within the same project, without inventing a response to the prior intervention.
